ENABLED.TITLE: Automatic distribution
ENABLED.DESCRIPTION: Enable this policy to control how conversations transferred to humans should be distributed.

OVERRIDE.TITLE: Override channel rule
OVERRIDE.DESCRIPTION: Use a specific rule for this team. When disabled, the team follows the channel-wide configuration.

DISTRIBUTION.TITLE: Agent login
DISTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: Define how the agent receives waiting conversations when they become available.
DISTRIBUTION.SINGLE_AGENT: Assign every waiting conversation when there is only one available agent in the team

REDISTRIBUTION.TITLE: Redistribution
REDISTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: Rules to move conversations when the first agent does not answer the customer.
REDISTRIBUTION.ENABLE_TIMEOUT: Redistribute if the agent does not answer within the configured time

UNAVAILABLE.TITLE: No available agent
UNAVAILABLE.DESCRIPTION: Choose what happens when the bot or system transfers a conversation and no agent is available.

BUSINESS_HOURS.TITLE: Business hours
BUSINESS_HOURS.DESCRIPTION: Define whether this policy follows the channel schedule or uses team-specific availability.

SUPERVISOR_ALERT.TITLE: Supervisor alert
SUPERVISOR_ALERT.DESCRIPTION: Register waiting conversations for administrator or supervisor follow-up.
SUPERVISOR_ALERT.ENABLED: Alert supervisor when the customer is waiting

API.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the distribution policy.
API.COPY_ERROR: Could not copy the selected policy.

INBOX_SECTION.TITLE: Conversation distribution
INBOX_SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Configure this channel's general rule. Team-specific rules can override this configuration.
